name: Chen Full International Co., Ltd.
summary: Chen Full International Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in engineering and machinery businesses in Taiwan and internationally. It offers engineering services, including factory system engineering, cleanroom equipment system pipeline engineering, secondary piping line engineering, dismantling/installing piping works, on-site service, and related pipe sales. The company provides machinery business, such as front helper, middle/rear helper, bottom press, cutting machine, and automation equipment.
